task: Restore the sanctioned recovery path so a PLAN-phase worktree'd story whose frozen checklist title a scope review flagged can be edited, re-reviewed, and re-advanced, without git surgery or hand-editing checklist.json.
outcome: From inside the story worktree at PLAN, the maintainer runs `lattice story_advance '{"storyId":"B-x","phase":"INIT","reason":"scope review flagged the frozen title"}'` and sees `Story B-x advanced to INIT`. They then run `lattice checklist_update '{"storyId":"B-x","itemId":"CHK-001","title":"<new deliverable-naming title>"}'` and it succeeds instead of being rejected. After re-running the INIT review and `lattice story_advance phase=INIT_CHECK` (which prints `Story B-x advanced to INIT_CHECK` reusing the existing worktree, not `Branch ... does not contain .worktrees/...`) and `phase=PLAN`, the story is back at PLAN carrying the corrected title. No `git` commands and no manual edit of checklist.json were needed.
facts: machine.ts PLAN state (xstate + canSendStoryEventWithoutSnapshotCan) has only a START->DEV edge; there is no backward edge from PLAN to INIT_CHECK or INIT (verified; machine probe PLAN--INIT_CHECK-->allowed=false).

transition-orchestrator.ts resolves the event as PHASE_TO_EVENT[targetPhase] plus a single hardcoded REPLAN special case (args.phase==='PLAN' && story.phase==='DEV'); no PLAN->INIT mapping exists (line ~611-618).

worktree.ts dev_start reuse early-return (line ~818) calls resolveWorktreePath which joins story.worktree.path against getRepoRoot() (git --show-toplevel = the worktree itself when run from inside it), double-nesting to a non-existent path so it clears story.worktree and re-bootstraps; the re-bootstrap computes storyRel against resolveMainRepoRoot() (git --git-common-dir = main), yielding a .worktrees/<id>/-prefixed path that the branch-content guard (line ~912) false-fails.
story.worktree.path is ALWAYS main-repo-root-relative ('.worktrees/<id>'), so resolveWorktreePath should resolve it against the main repo root for all callers, not --show-toplevel.
checklist.ts titleContextProtectedPhases includes INIT_CHECK, so title/context is editable only at INIT; the guidance at line ~666 ('story_advance back to INIT_CHECK') is self-contradictory.

Two independent INIT reviewers (lattice-review-story-init + product-reviewer) verified all three claims against source and passed with 0 issues; repro is bound as story-evidence-binding seb-ms08pthg-ybzc4e from probe rp-ms08p73e-rdc1ts (red-reviewed target-bug).
constraints: Do NOT weaken the INIT_CHECK scope-freeze invariant: INIT_CHECK stays in titleContextProtectedPhases; only INIT unfreezes title/context.
The reopen must be gated and auditable: require a reason and allow it only from PLAN (pre-REVIEW).
Preserve byte-identical behavior for all existing transitions and for dev_start when run from the main root.
The re-advance INIT->INIT_CHECK from inside the existing worktree must reuse the worktree (dev_start early-return), not re-bootstrap.
